issue: Featured products "View all" link does not filter to featured-only products

evidence: Sorting by price on /products page correctly orders products ascending: Philips Hue $199 → ... → Peloton Bike+ $2,495.

evidence: Samsung Galaxy S24 Ultra product detail page displays name, category, price, rating, full description/review, and specifications consistently with data shown on listing pages.

issue: New tags added via admin edit do not appear in the /products Tags filter panel
actual: Edited Bowflex SelectTech 552 tags via admin, adding new tags "home-fitness" and "qa-verified-2026" (replacing "home-gym" and "strength"). Product detail page correctly shows the updated tag chips (weights, dumbbells, home-fitness, qa-verified-2026). However, the /products page's Tags filter panel still lists the old tags "home-gym" and "strength" and does not include "home-fitness" or "qa-verified-2026" — the filter tag list is not derived from current product data, so the new tags cannot be selected as filter choices.

evidence: Via admin edit on Bowflex SelectTech 552: added a new tag (qa-verified-2026), renamed "home-gym" to "home-fitness", and removed "strength". Product detail page correctly reflects the final tag set (weights, dumbbells, home-fitness, qa-verified-2026) with no stale tags shown on the product itself.

Opened "Add Product" form and clicked "Create Product" with all fields empty (no name, no short description, price=0). Created a new product "QA Test Smart Speaker" via admin "Add Product" form with name, category, price, rating, image, affiliate link, tags (including new tag "qa-new-tag-2026"), description, review, and a spec. Product appeared correctly in /products listing (10 products found) with correct data, and searching by its unique new tag "qa-new-tag-2026" correctly returned exactly that product (1 product found), confirming the new tag participates in keyword search.

Verified across multiple products (Bowflex SelectTech 552, Sony WH-1000XM5, QA Test Smart Speaker) that category and tag values shown on listing/browse views (category badges, tag chips) exactly match those shown on the product detail view — no discrepancies observed. New/edited tags and categories propagate consistently between browsing and detail views.

For QA Test Smart Speaker and Samsung Galaxy S24 Ultra, name/category/price/rating/short description shown identically on /products listing and product detail page. Detail page additionally displays the full, untruncated review text and complete specifications table (e.g., "Connectivity: Wi-Fi, Bluetooth 5.0") not shown on listing cards.

issue: Admin panel changes (new products, edits) do not persist across a page reload/revisit
actual: Created "QA Test Smart Speaker" via admin and confirmed it live in the app (10 products, searchable by tag, visible on detail page). After a hard reload of its detail page URL, the product returned "Product Not Found". Reloading /products showed only the original 9 products — the new product was gone, and previously edited products (Sony WH-1000XM5 Wireless→reverted to "Sony WH-1000XM5", Bowflex's category change back to Fitness) also reverted to their original seed values. Admin changes exist only in transient client-side state and are not persisted to any backend/storage that survives a reload.
